preconditions.description: N is an integer greater than 1.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(edgeList, list) and all(isinstance(edge, list) and len(edge) == 3 and isinstance(edge[0], int) and isinstance(edge[1], int) and isinstance(edge[2], int) and edge[0] < edge[1] for edge in edgeList)
preconditions.description: edgeList is a list of weighted edges, where each edge is a list of three integers [start, end, weight] and start < end.

postconditions.description: The result is -1 if there is no path from node 0 to node N-1, or the weight of the shortest path otherwise.
